description: Edits that keep removing the same phrases become rules

edits.before: I am passionate about building products and I am writing to apply for this role.
edits.after: I build products that customers use every day.

edits.before: I am truly passionate about data platforms!
edits.after: I have spent four years on data platforms.

edits.before: I am writing to apply for the Product Lead position.
edits.after: Your Product Lead role fits what I have done for the last four years.

rules: Don't open with 'I am writing to apply'; start with the concrete reason.
